standards_review.notes: All 5 subjects match EPMCDME-####: Description format: EPMCDME-14433: Add router-level tests for combined budget_usage response; EPMCDME-14433: Add _expand_project_rows and extend get_budget_usage; EPMCDME-14433: Add dual-marker freshness latch to MemberSpendService; EPMCDME-14433: Extract get_user_project_spend_rows and use batched cutoff; EPMCDME-14433: Add batched reset-cutoff repository method

License headers present in all 3 new source files; from __future__ import annotations present; modern X | None unions used throughout. Violation: code-quality.md forbids bare list/dict annotations and requires parameterized generics. member_spend_service.py uses list[dict] (bare dict) as the return type of _category_columns (line 49), as a local variable annotation (line 55), and as part of the return type of get_user_project_spend (line 196) and get_project_member_spend (line 239). The correct form is list[dict[str, Any]].

No credential or token logging found in changed files; log messages record safe context only (project_name, user_id, snapshot counts). Auth dependencies are not modified. All SQL queries use ORM-parameterised expressions; the one f-string in text() at project_spend_tracking_repository.py:485 interpolates only the internal constant spend_subject_type, which is passed exclusively as hardcoded string literals from insert_project_budget_entries and insert_member_budget_entries, never from user input. No untrusted input handling issues identified.

blocking_findings.violation: code-quality.md forbids bare list/dict annotations and requires parameterized generics (e.g. list[str], dict[str, Any]). _category_columns is annotated -> list[dict], the local variable columns on line 55 is typed list[dict], and the return types of get_user_project_spend and get_project_member_spend include list[dict] in their tuple annotations.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: Partially-met blocking standard: type annotation completeness is a documented blocking code-quality rule and list[dict] leaves dict unparameterised.
blocking_findings.remedy: Replace every list[dict] occurrence in this file with list[dict[str, Any]]; Any is already imported from typing.
